Liam (Support): escalating Veloxy (acct vel-9981) — embeddings ingest returning 403 on batch upload since ~09:12 PST, onboarding stalled, trial at risk. priority P1. Need CS to own comms + enablement before EOD.

```json

Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
{...}

{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope: ingest:write\"}
```

Aisha (CS): @Liam got it — tagging @Priya and @Tom. I'll take lead on customer comms. Can someone confirm whether we can do a temporary quota bump and who owns approval?

Priya (CS Ops): small one-off quota increases are on our self-serve workflow, I can approve up to +20% for trials. For larger bumps need finance sign-off. Send me acct id and desired uplift.

Tom (Solutions): quick hypothesis: 403 -> api key scope mismatch or missing `X-Org-ID` header after the last SDK release. Ask devs to check key scopes and the integration header. Quick test command to reproduce locally:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest/batch -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc" -H "X-Org-ID: vel-9981" -d '{"items":[{"id":"1","text":"hello"}]}'
```

Ben (Sales): adding color — renewal window is EOM (30 days). Onboarding slip = high churn risk. I'll prep an executive note if we escalate.

Aisha (CS): Proposed comms plan (timeboxed):
- 0-30m: send immediate trust-preserving email to PM + engineering contact (Aisha + Liam)
- 24h: schedule guided ingest session + live troubleshooting (Tom lead)
- 24h: offer temporary quota bump for 24h if it helps unblock (Priya)
- 48h: follow-up with risk assessment and exec summary for Sales (Ben)
Please confirm owners. @Liam, customer contact?

Liam (Support): contact = sara@veloxy-app.com (Sara Lee, PM). Ticket SUP-8742 created. I triggered a staging quota bump; production still blocked. Full request/response attached in ticket.

Aisha (CS): I'm drafting the email now. Will cc @Ben. If we don't get a response within 48h we escalate to AM + CSM manager. :warning:

Tom (Solutions): I'll join an enablement call at 13:00 PST and run the reproduce steps. Adding a short test script to thread:

```python
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
